_help: One entry per trophy, in page order. place: a final place (1, 2, 3 ...), "last" for last place, or "consolation" for the consolation bracket winner (the best finisher who missed the playoffs). historicPlace, if set, is used instead for the hand-entered 2021-2025 seasons. art: gold, silver, bronze, toilet or last. hardware: true counts it toward the Most trophies record.
